_comment: T2 rung (a) — cb_kaula_prior ALONE (docs/SPEC_synthetic_minimum_network.md §14 T2 (measured record §12.8.3)).
The field arms network.cb_kaula_prior (sigma 3 m); every sim rung so far ran
without it.  The BeiDou card measured the Kaula prior LIFTING near-null
directions by construction, so this is the most likely single explanation
for the field emitting at 303 stations with the DEFAULT rank-gate tolerance.
Question for this rung: does the (code-bias) Kaula prior lift the L2W
satellite PHASE-bias common mode (9.78e-06 without it) above the default
cutoff?  It is a code-side prior, so a pass here would mean the lift is
indirect (through the CB|iono coupling); a rank-gate withhold here means the
phase-side near-null needs a phase-side answer and the field's emission
DEFAULT tolerance on purpose; 20 epochs decides a rank question at epoch 1.
